facts.en: Earned a business administration diploma at Fictional Saffronbridge College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构藏红花桥学院获得工商管理文凭。

facts.en: Paid domestic order clerk at Fictional Cedarcrate Packaging from 2018-07 to 2021-05.
facts.zh: 2018-07 至 2021-05 在虚构雪松箱包装公司任有薪国内订单文员。

facts.en: Paid international customer service specialist at Fictional Blueharbour Components from 2021-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-06 至 2026-08 在虚构蓝港零部件公司任有薪国际客户服务专员。

facts.en: Checks customer purchase orders against approved item codes, prices and delivery terms in the order system.
facts.zh: 在订单系统中依据获批物料代码、价格及交付条款核对客户采购订单。

facts.en: Sends English order confirmations and explains confirmed dispatch dates using approved templates.
facts.zh: 使用获批模板发送英文订单确认，并解释已确认发货日期。

facts.en: Tracks open order lines and obtains revised availability dates from production planners.
facts.zh: 跟踪未完成订单行，并向生产计划人员获取修订后的供货日期。

facts.en: Collects shipment references and forwards document discrepancies to the logistics team.
facts.zh: 收集货运编号，并将单证差异转交物流团队。

facts.en: The logistics team and appointed broker prepare customs declarations; the candidate supplies order data.
facts.zh: 物流团队及指定代理编制报关单；候选人提供订单数据。

facts.en: Helped reconcile a 2025-11 backlog extract before the monthly customer update.
facts.zh: 在月度客户更新前协助核对一份 2025-11 积压订单导出记录。

facts.en: The extract contained 84 open order lines across 29 customer orders, not 84 separate orders.
facts.zh: 该导出记录包含 29 份客户订单中的 84 条未完成订单行，而非 84 份独立订单。

facts.en: Personally reconciled promised dates on 52 lines; a colleague handled the remaining 32 lines.
facts.zh: 个人核对 52 条订单行的承诺日期；一名同事处理其余 32 条。

facts.en: The reconciliation clarified missing dates on 9 lines; it did not demonstrate that those lines were shipped.
facts.zh: 核对工作明确了 9 条订单行缺失的日期；该工作未证明这些订单行已发货。

facts.en: Uses an ERP order module, spreadsheet filters and shared customer correspondence logs.
facts.zh: 使用 ERP 订单模块、电子表格筛选及共享客户往来通信日志。

facts.en: Completed a non-award evening course in written business English in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年完成不授予资格的商务英语写作夜间课程。

facts.en: Uses English for routine written customer communication; no language test score or professional translation credential is recorded.
facts.zh: 使用英语处理日常书面客户沟通；未记录语言考试成绩或专业翻译资质。

facts.en: Escalates requested price exceptions and commercial disputes to the account manager.
facts.zh: 将客户请求的价格例外及商务争议升级交给客户经理。

facts.en: Volunteers with Fictional Quiltpost Community Exchange, maintaining a sign-up list for noncommercial craft swaps.
facts.zh: 在虚构拼被邮社区交换团体做志愿者，为非商业手工交换维护报名清单。

facts.en: Created a personal bilingual picture glossary of invented craft tools in 2024 for enjoyment.
facts.zh: 2024 年为消遣制作个人双语图解词汇表，内容为虚构手工工具。

facts.en: Enjoys making folded-paper storage boxes and drawing imaginary shop signs.
facts.zh: 爱好制作折纸收纳盒及绘制想象中的店铺招牌。

facts.en: Prepares handovers separating confirmed dispatches, pending production dates and unresolved commercial requests.
facts.zh: 准备交接记录，区分已确认发货、待定生产日期及尚未解决的商务请求。
